summary: Accepted as the Step 5 smoothing direction: PC1-removed embeddings + a candidate-evidence source floor (best of four reviewed variants, ~80% good fit). Step 5 is analysis-only, so this records the recommended direction, not a serving change. Known residual: bleed concentrates in low-evidence multi-word compounds (5 of 6 remaining bleeds). Future lever, to pull if/when this config is promoted toward serving (Steps 7-9): a compound-aware evidence floor (require higher source support for multi-token fillers).
